title: Full Day: Christ Redeemer, Sugarloaf, City Tour & Barbecue Lunch
overview: Get an overview of Rio's most important sights during this comprehensive daytour. With a local guide, travel through the Tijuca Forest, stopping at Paineiras to board transportation to the top of Corcovado, home of the Christ the Redeemer statue. Take the cable car from Urca up to the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, eat lunch at one of the city's best steakhouses (if upgrade is selected), and tick off Maracanã Stadium and the Sambadrome. Round-trip transportation from Rio hotels is included.

title: Hang gliding Hang gliding Experience Rotorfly
overview: Fly over Rio de Janeiro on this hang gliding or paragliding tour. You do not need experience. Receive a short training session before heading off the Pedra Bonita ramp, located within the Tijuca National Park. Enjoy a unique perspective of the city before landing on São Conrado beach. Flight duration depends on weather conditions.
startDescription: Meet at BETO ROTOR - Asa Delta, Av. Pref. Mendes de Morais 1402, São Conrado, Rio de Janeiro. Optional hotel shuttle from the South Zone is listed separately.
highlights: Tandem hang-gliding or paragliding launch from the Pedra Bonita ramp in Tijuca National Park
Landing on São Conrado beach
Short training session before takeoff; no prior flight experience required
Helmet, emergency parachute, and Level 4 instructor included
GoPro photos and one video included; extra cameras listed separately

title: Full Day Excursion to Petrópolis from Rio de Janeiro
overview: Leave Rio de Janeiro for a full-day excursion to Petrópolis, the former imperial summer capital in the Serra dos Órgãos. An accredited guide covers the Imperial Museum with the included ticket, then continues to Palácio Quitandinha and the Santos Dumont House. A buffet lunch is included; drinks, desserts, and optional Bohemia Brewery entry are listed separately.
inclusions: Free buffet lunch (drinks and desserts not included)
